description: This file contains classes and functions for managing and executing a simulation environment involving FVP (Fixed Virtual Platform), including configuration parsing, process control, and telnet interactions.

classes.name: ConsolePortParser
classes.description: Parses console port information from log lines.

classes.name: FVPRunner
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of an FVP simulation process, including starting, stopping, and creating telnet/pexpect connections.

methods.name: cli_from_config
methods.description: Constructs command line arguments for FVP based on configuration.

methods.name: check_telnet
methods.description: Checks if telnet is available in the system.

methods.name: shlex_join
methods.description: Backported function to join command arguments into a shell-escaped string.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the FVP process with specified configuration and arguments.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the FVP process and associated connections.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the FVP process to complete.

methods.name: create_telnet
methods.description: Creates a telnet connection to the specified port.

methods.name: create_pexpect
methods.description: Creates a pexpect spawn object for telnet connection.

methods.name: pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the FVP process.
